 (At Present Lodged In District Jail, Chittorgarh)

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp
----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. OP Sangwa For Respondent(s) : Mr. Laxman Solanki, PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI Order 14/08/2024 1.

Through this bail application, accused has come before this Court for grant of bail under section 439 of the Cr.P.C. (Section 483 of BNSS, 2023) in connection with crime registered pursuant to First Information Report No.07/2023 of Cyber Police Station, District Chittorgarh in respect of offences punishable under Sections 66-D of I.T. Act and Sections 420 and 120-B of the Indian Penal Code,
1860.
2.
I have considered the rival submissions of learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned Public Prosecutor and perused the record.

3. Learned Public Prosecutor for the State has strongly objected the different submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant and submitted that in the facts of the present case, it is expedient that accused be kept in the custody.
He thus, craves rejection of the applicant's bail application.

[2024:RJ-JD:33814] (2 of 2) [CRLMB-9726/2024]

entities.text: Vinod Kumar Meena vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:33814)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I have given my anxious consideration to the rival submissions with reference to material placed before me.

5. On perusal of the record and upon consideration of the submissions, it would be clear that according to the case spelled out in the FIR, the allegation against the petitioner is cheating of amount to the tune of Rs.5,50,000/-.
Co-accused Vikas has already been enlarged on bail.
The case is exclusively triable by Magistrate court and trial of the case will take sufficient time to conclude.
Therefore, this Court is of the opinion that it is a fit case for grant of indulgence of bail to the petitioner.

6. Consequently, the present bail application is allowed and it is directed that the accused-petitioner Vinod Kumar Meena S/o Shri Kumbharam Meena, arrested in connection with the F.I.R.
No.07/2023 of Cyber Police Station, District Chittorgarh shall be released on bail provided he furnishes a personal bond and two surety bonds of sufficient amount to the satisfaction of the learned trial court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.

This order is subject to the condition that accused, within 7 days of his release, and sureties on the day of furnishing bail, will also furnish details of their all bank accounts,
with bank and branch name, in shape of an affidavit, and submit legible copy of their Aadhar cards as well as copy of front page of Bank pass book, for smooth recovery of penalty amount, if there arise a need for recovery of penalty under Section 446 Cr.P.C in future.
(RAJENDRA PRAKASH SONI),J 63-Payal/-
